//: P43 coverage ledger. Every dsl/<cat>/<name>.json workflow must be accounted for: either it carries offline smoke states in bench/dsl_smoke_states.json (behaviour-verified by `laya-workflow dsl smoke`), or it is listed under `live_only` with the gate that verifies it (`covered_by`) and why the offline smoke cannot. `laya-workflow dsl smoke` fails on a spec that is neither (a workflow that would otherwise be silently unverified), and fails on a stale entry (one whose spec is now offline-registered or no longer exists), so this ledger cannot rot.
